name: Aldrias Varet
source:
A Reanimator by assignment, Aldrias is actually a scholar at heart.

Highly intelligent, if a bit scatterbrained,he loves reading anything and everything he can get his hands on.
With a kind, gentle disposition, Aldrias has a big heart and an even bigger dream-making Nalenshir a better place, starting with revolutionizing the career system for mages and improving welfare.
